summary: Texas turns from its Ohio State comeback to UTSA with Cooper expected back and Townsend unlikely to play, according to Sarkisian’s Thursday update. Watch the goal-line blocking and whether the defense can finish possessions.

items.headline: Coleman added a sixth offensive lineman on the goal line
items.tldr: Watch the extra blocker when Texas gets close to the end zone. The package helped create room against Ohio State; the next test is finishing without needing a late comeback.

items.headline: Sarkisian expects Cooper back; Townsend is unlikely to play
items.tldr: Thursday’s update points toward more backfield depth, while the tight ends need to cover Townsend’s role. Check the final availability update before kickoff.

items.headline: Texas shut Ohio State out in the fourth quarter
items.tldr: Watch the coverage discipline after halftime carry into the opening series. Getting off the field would give the offense room to settle.

items.headline: UTSA converted two fourth downs on its winning drive
items.tldr: Prepare for an opponent willing to extend possessions. Watch McCown’s keeper as well as the short pass when Texas needs one more stop.

items.headline: Orangebloods reports a one-game suspension for Nansen
items.tldr: Watch the linebacker communication against UTSA. The report concerns Saturday’s coaching availability; it does not establish a permanent staffing change.

lead.headline: Finish the drive.
lead.body: Watch the extra blocker near the goal line and the available tight ends in the passing game. Texas needs useful early possessions before another comeback becomes necessary.

matchup.question: What should Texas carry into UTSA?
matchup.answer: Build drives with the running backs, use the tight end when the outside throw is covered, and defend through fourth down.
